nom: Forge Skin Face Moisturizer for Men Wrinkle Defense Beef Tallow Balm

segments.sensitive: The one reviewer who describes her own skin as sensitive and semi-oily reports the balm gave her a rash on her forehead, cheeks, and neck by the second day of use.
segments.dry: Reviewers describe the balm as a practical daily moisturizer for dry skin, especially after shaving, with one crediting it with highly moisturizing results when she tried the jar meant for her husband's dry skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s to 70s report visible improvements — reduced wrinkles, less puffiness, firmer skin, and in one case fading sun-damage spots — though one reviewer says it did not improve much for a 61-year-old friend with baggy eyes.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, mostly men in their 50s to 70s, report fewer visible wrinkles, reduced puffiness and eye bags, and firmer-looking skin within two to three weeks of regular use; dissenting reviewers report no visible difference after several weeks of twice-daily use, including one 61-year-old whose baggy eyes did not improve.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the balm hydrates well and absorbs without a greasy residue, including for dry skin and dry patches, leaving skin feeling softer and less puffy.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the balm avoided the eye irritation that other men's face products typically cause for him; another reviewer with sensitive, semi-oily skin developed a rash on her forehead, cheeks, and neck by the second day of use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with sun-damaged, aging skin reports dark spots visibly fading by the third week of use, alongside a healthier-looking glow; this is the only detailed report on spots in the reviews supplied.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports that a reformulated version of the balm is thicker than the original and plugs her pores; no other reviewer specifically discusses breakouts or blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer describes the balm as a little greasy on his skin while noting others may not have the same experience; most other reviewers report it absorbs without leaving an oily or greasy feel.

aspects.libelle: Very small container relative to price
Packaging difficult to open, sometimes damaged or leaking on arrival
Concerns about ingredient authenticity or origin
Light, pleasant scent that fades quickly
Absorbs quickly without heavy greasy residue
Some reviewers report a thicker, more pore-clogging reformulation

extraits.titre: Not So Great!!! Waste Of Money!!
extraits.texte: I got it two days ago, is very small for the price! I have sensitive semi-oily skin and on the second day of use it gave me a rash like on my forehead cheeks and part of my neck! It’s got a lot of ingredients including alcohol and I noticed it’s made in China! Very disappointed on this product!!!

Use twice a day morning and night with a clean face. And dry face with no difference. First picture was September 15th day I got product second picture is on October 8th. No difference. I would give it zero stars if I had that option.

My friend wanted this so I ordered for him. He has baggy eyes and use it up. It didn’t improve that much for him so it’s okay, not that great. Sometimes it not for everyone as they have different skins. He is 61 years old.

I bought this balm during their holiday sale after reading so many reviews about it. I'm 58 years old and dealing with aging skin, sun damage from years of outdoor work, and overall tired-looking skin. I honestly didn't expect much - I've tried countless products over the years with minimal results. When I received the Forge Beef Tallow Balm, the first thing that surprised me was the packaging. Very professional, and when I opened it, I was worried it might smell like beef or grease, but it has this subtle, clean scent that's actually pleasant. My wife even commented on how nice it smelled, which was unexpected. I use it once in the morning and sometimes before bed. The first week of using this balm, I noticed how quickly it absorbed - no greasy residue at all. My skin felt instantly softer and more hydrated. By day 3, my wife said my skin looked "different" but couldn't pinpoint why. By the second week, the changes were noticeable. The deep lines around my eyes started looking less pronounced, and my skin had this firmness I hadn't seen in years. My usual morning puffiness was significantly reduced, and people at work started asking if I'd been on vacation because I looked "rested." The third week was when I really saw dramatic changes. The dark spots from sun damage started fading, and my skin had this healthy glow I hadn't seen in probably 20 years. My wife's friend actually asked her if I'd had "work done" because I looked so much younger. That's when I knew this stuff wa

I specifically ordered this tallow face cream for my husband, hoping that he would stop taking my products when his skin feels dry. Unfortunately (for him) that plan backfired, because I like this so much I kept it for myself. This moisturizer is tallow-based, which makes sense because it seems that animal fat should be a good way to keep the skin from drying out. It also includes hyaluronic acid and collagen, two of my favorite ingredients in anti-aging products. The lotion is a pale, yellow cream that is smooth and very mildly citrus scented. It goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. A little goes a long way, which is a good thing, because this jar contains less than 2 fluid ounces, not a lot. The black jar and the marketing appear to be directed toward the male market, but this is highly moisturizing, making it a nice night cream for almost anyone.

I never used a tallow moisturizer before, but figured I would give it a shot. I am pleasantly surprised with this, it doesn’t have any smell that I have noticed, and my skin absorbs it pretty well. It is a little greasy on my skin, but I know others may not have the same experience. Other than the greasiness it does leave my skin looking good.

They say it’s the same product just a different package, but that’s a lie. The new stuff is much thicker and plugs my pores. Would never buy it again unless they go back to the old style. Original is smooth and silky this crap is pasty and smells nothing like the original!
